title: Linxira Bio output specification
description: Declares the artifact set an analysis projects from its authoritative JSON result. The JSON envelope stays the single source of truth; every artifact is a reversible projection rendered by the unified output writers. schema_version must be the integer version "1" (never "1.0").

capability.description: The capability id producing these artifacts, e.g. expression.differential.v1.

role.description: Artifact role, e.g. sequences, variants, table, figure.

format.description: On-disk format; only formats with unified writers are eligible here.

path.description: Workspace-relative POSIX path; absolute paths and backslash separators are rejected.

columns.description: Column-name override for tabular artifacts; defaults derive from the records.

header.description: Extra header lines (VCF meta lines, SAM @SQ lines) emitted after the built-in header.

coords.description: On-disk coordinate convention override; JSON interval coordinates are always 1-based closed and each format defaults to its native convention (bed = 0-based half-open).
